text:
maya: Heads up — booking window for p4d in us-west-2 jumped to ~14 days today. We have 3 critical booking requests from model-team for demos next month, need a hedging plan.
samir: Any ETA on what caused the spike? new infra deploy or customer commit?
maya: Graph looks like capacity commitments spiked after the enterprise onboarding. Quick CLI snapshot: ```resvctl show --region usw2 --class p4d --summary``` -> shows 92% committed, 6d median leadtime -> now 14d.
infra-bot: ALERT: capacity-commitments/usw2/p4d > 80% (auto-threshold). Created incident INC-2041-capacity-01.
leo: We can either: 1) push for immediate reserved commit (cost save, but locks capacity) or 2) open a temporary spot-burst pool + cross-region burst. Both have tradeoffs.
ops-elena: Cross-region burst ok from ops side but increases egress and latency for some customers. Billing impact needs review, pinging @billing-sys.
billing-sys: Saw a billing anomaly last week where a duplicate commit charge was applied and was reversed (INV-2026-07). We can do laddered commitments but note pro-ration rules — short ladders incur higher effective unit cost.
samir: Proposal: "commitment ladder" — two smaller 30d commitments now (to cover demos) + one scoped 90d commit if usage stabilizes. That limits exposure.
maya: Can we also enable a short-lived spot-burst autoscaler to shave peak. I can draft the patch: ```kubectl apply -f spot-burst-policy.yaml``` with target max 20% of peak.
leo: If we go ladder + spot-burst, add fallback routing to model-small variants to keep SLAs if queued. Also add a canary capacity holdback of 10% for enterprise customers.
ops-elena: I want a manual approval path for any committed buys > $Xk/mo. Can someone open an approvals ticket? @infra-team take this.
infra-team: Taking it. We'll assemble cost estimates and a region-fallback plan by EOD.
maya: I'll open a manual procurement ticket and add demo timelines. Also adding the short-term cost calc: "approx +$12k for 30d small commits vs +$35k for 90d large" — rough numbers.
samir: Quick note — check quota in eu-central-1 before planning cross-region shift; recent capacity churn there too.
infra-bot: NOTE: Scheduled maint in usw2 on 2041239000 UTC may temporarily affect allocations — confirm before commit.
leo: OK. If we get infra-team + billing sign-off, I vote to proceed with the ladder tomorrow morning to hit the earliest demo.
ops-elena: :thumbsup: If everybody agrees, I'll pre-authorize emergency spot budget up to $3k for the burst pool.
billing-sys: Once infra-team posts the cost estimate, I'll flag any invoice risks and set alerting for duplicate charges.
maya: Thanks — I'll create the PR for the spot-burst autoscaler and attach the cost sheet. Will also add fallback routing rules and a short runway checklist.
samir: Sounds good. Minimal follow-ups: add the model-team demo times to the ticket and tag product for SLA sign-off.
maya: On it. Updating thread with links as I get them. :eyes:
